adaptation_briefs.brief: RBI buys20 crore bonds, reserve inflow20 crore, reserve ratio20%, no cash leakage/excess reserves. Ask increase in maximum deposit capacity.
Reserves fixed100 crore, no leakage/excess reserves. Required ratio rises20% to25%. Ask old/new maximum deposits and reduction.
Bank rate increases; ask standard textbook sequence among borrowing cost, reserves and money supply. Use tends-to language; reject a guaranteed realised outcome.
adaptation_briefs.answer_basis: Borrowing cost rises; reserves and money supply tend to fall.

adaptation_briefs.brief: Ask which textbook operation tends to withdraw reserves when the RBI wants to contract money supply, contrasting bond purchase/sale and their payment directions.
Match purchase with specified resale date/price to repo and permanent purchase without later commitment to outright OMO. Use complete disjoint mapping alternatives.
adaptation_briefs.answer_basis: Resale terms: repo; no later commitment: outright.

adaptation_briefs.brief: Central bank sells securities with agreed repurchase date/price. Ask the arrangement and whether it withdraws rather than supplies money under the source framing.

Match general central-bank lending rate in this textbook paragraph to Bank Rate, security repurchase lending to repo rate, and money withdrawn under reverse arrangement to reverse repo rate. Avoid MSF and current rate values.
adaptation_briefs.answer_basis: Bank Rate, repo rate, reverse repo rate respectively.

adaptation_briefs.brief: Standalone historical stem identifies Independence/Five-Year Plan context; ask broader role beyond annual receipts/expenditure. Avoid unidentified chapter dependency.
Match government borrowing, PSU share sale and tax collection to debt-creating capital, non-debt capital and revenue receipts respectively.
adaptation_briefs.answer_basis: Liability creation; asset reduction; tax revenue.

adaptation_briefs.brief: A learner says capital receipts must both create debt and reduce assets. Ask which government transaction disproves this: sell an asset without borrowing; alternatives are revenue receipts or expenditure.
adaptation_briefs.answer_basis: Asset sale without debt is still a capital receipt.

adaptation_briefs.brief: Identify true statements: a tax receipt is nonredeemable revenue; fresh borrowing creates a liability; a government asset sale reduces financial assets. Include debt-required-for-all-capital as false.
adaptation_briefs.answer_basis: First three true; universal debt condition false.

Government changes fixed rate60 to75 rupees per dollar. Ask depreciation/appreciation/devaluation/revaluation with exact regime and quotation.
Use complete registered leec106 page8 import-demand paragraph: more foreign travel shifts dollar demand right; hold supply fixed. Ask dollar-price/rupee-value direction.

Use full registered page7 four-arrow paragraph. Match household factor services, firm factor payments, firm goods, household purchases to factor-real, factor-money, goods-real, goods-money respectively.
Use registered page6 paragraph listing factors. Match labour, capital, entrepreneurship and land to wage, interest, profit and rent, with four distinct permutation alternatives.
Explicit simple no-saving/no-tax/no-trade model, all500 crore sales paid as factor income. Wages200, rent50, interest40 crore; ask profit residual. State no intermediate inputs/depreciation here.
Use exact registered page2 inventory paragraph: planned addition100, unforeseen extra sales30. Ask actual addition and unplanned component defined as actual minus planned.
Disposable income divided only into consumption/saving; planned income100 and consumption75, actual income90 and consumption70. Ask actual-minus-planned saving and whether it is a shortfall.
adaptation_briefs.answer_basis: Planned25, actual20; shortfall5 in stated units.

adaptation_briefs.brief: Define C,I,G,X,M. Omit government and foreign sector; state investment positive. Ask AD expression among C+I, C+G, I+X-M and C+I+G with mutually exclusive numeric examples if symbolic options would coincide.
adaptation_briefs.answer_basis: AD=C+I; use expressions whose evaluated values are disjoint.
